content.title: Single-Image Product Expansion | Whole First, Component Proof, Hero Return
content.summary: A climbing glove expands into grip, ventilation and closure proofs before pair closure. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: The complete product appears before decomposition. + Every macro remains registered to the baseline grid. + Each component proves one named function. + Duplication creates a controlled product pair. + All components return to a complete hero composition.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show one complete fictional charcoal-and-lime climbing glove on a black coordinate grid. Use thin lime lines to trace each component boundary on the same coordinates. Return every proof to one complete two-glove hero composition and hold without copy.
required_anchors: The complete product appears before decomposition.
Every macro remains registered to the baseline grid.
Duplication creates a controlled product pair.
All components return to a complete hero composition.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A climbing glove expands into grip, ventilation and closure proofs before pair closure. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
